dedupe_keys.name: road traffic events statistics poland komenda głowna policji

description: The Polish National Police Headquarters publishes statistics on road traffic events on the national open data portal. The resource gives the number of accidents and collisions broken down by criteria such as the place of the event, the causes, pedestrian behaviour, the vehicle of the perpetrator, the age of the driver at fault, months, days of the week and hours, for the years 2015 to 2021. Coverage is national (Poland). The tables are free under CC BY 4.0 on dane.gov.pl as CSV, XLS and XLSX files, and the dataset is marked as updated yearly (last modified March 2026). Caveats: the data are aggregated tables, not geolocated event records, and the period covered ends in 2021. They support road safety analysis, calibration of accident models by road environment and exposure studies. They complement the GB STATS19 and Northern Ireland collision data catalogued here.
